args.body:
label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

You can check the running version by calling the health endpoint: `GET /api/v1/health` (see docs/API.md) returns a JSON body including `version`, which is also shown as "Current version" in README.md and matches the version field in package.json. 

Note: I haven't closed the other issues you listed (#4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, #4406) — bulk-closing issues on a reporter's say-so isn't something this triage process does; a maintainer should verify each was actually fixed by the upgrade before closing it.
